messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Ordering bars in ggplot within a group
parts:
You are using "Conc" to assign your fill, therefore you need to change the levels of Conc and not Trmt. 

trtslope$Conc <- factor( as.character(trtslope$Conc), levels= c("None","10^-11","10^-10","10^-9"))

trtslopeplot

HTH, 

B
